evidence: app/app/pages/abilities/[name].vue — entire ability route is one file
app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:144-154 — Abilities section is one self-contained PageSection block
app/server/api/pokemon/[name].get.ts:85-89 — abilities field drops out with the section
app/app/components/SiteHeader.vue:8-10 — no ability nav link to chase
removability.rationale: Deleting Abilities means removing two files plus the spec-mandated section on the Pokémon page (template, page interface, server payload) — a handful of edits, but every one is greppable via 'abilit' and nothing is left dangling.

evidence: app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:54 — spriteUrl is the single source for move/ability/type/team card sprites (via cardsFor:88)
app/app/pages/index.vue:48 — home page re-implements the sprite URL inline, bypassing spriteUrl
app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:39 and app/app/composables/format.ts:1 — humanize implemented twice, identically
changeability.rationale: Most fixes (sorting logic in MovesTable, 404 handling in withNotFound, page titles in usePageTitle) land in one place, but the two most bug-prone bits — sprite URLs and name formatting — are duplicated client/server, so those fixes land in two places with divergence risk.

evidence: app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts — all PokeAPI access and caching behind one thin module; pages never fetch PokeAPI directly
app/app/composables/format.ts:23 — usePageData gives pages a single narrow seam to their /api endpoint
app/app/components/CardList.vue:2-4 — components take plain prop shapes, no cross-component imports of internals
app/app/pages/index.vue:18 — page reaches into runtimeConfig.public.apiBase to build media URLs itself, leaking server-side knowledge into the client
app/app/components/TypeBadge.vue:14 — component assumes a --type-<name> CSS var exists per type name (implicit contract with tokens.css)
coupling.rationale: Server/client separation is exemplary (a real BFF with narrow endpoints), but the home page knowing the media URL scheme and the duplicated humanize break the otherwise clean separation.

evidence: app/app/components/PageSection.vue — one component covers every section's region/heading contract
app/app/components/CardList.vue — shared by home, move, ability and type pages; sorting by name could be added once
app/app/components/MovesTable.vue:13-27 — sortable-column design generalizes across learn-method tables; showLevel flag is the one flag parameter and is justified
app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:81-91 — cardsFor encodes the real variation (alternate forms, dedupe, dex order, hidden) rather than flag params
app/app/composables/team.ts:7-31 — useTeam isolates all team state behind members/has/add/remove/toggle
abstraction_design.rationale: The components and data helpers are designed around the app's actual variation points and stretch to new sections without copying; the gap is that the Card payload type is redeclared four times instead of shared, and no shared module exists for client/server-common logic.

findings.issue: Home page builds sprite URLs inline (`${mediaBase}/media/sprites/pokemon/${s.id}.png`), duplicating and bypassing server/utils/pokeapi.ts:54 spriteUrl used by every other card list
findings.suggestion: Have /api/species return ready-made sprite URLs (or at least route the client through one shared spriteUrl helper) so a sprite fix is one edit

findings.issue: humanize is implemented twice (server/utils/pokeapi.ts:39 and here); Nuxt 4's shared/ directory exists precisely for client+server code
findings.suggestion: Move humanize (and any future shared formatters) to app/shared/ so both sides import one implementation

findings.issue: The Card shape is declared four times (pokeapi.ts Card, CardList props, PokemonCard props, per-page interfaces) with no single exported type
findings.suggestion: Export one Card type from a shared module and reference it from components and page interfaces

findings.issue: Page duplicates apiBase trailing-slash normalization and knows the media path scheme, leaking data-source details into the client
findings.suggestion: Serve sprite URLs from /api/species (or a useMediaBase composable) so only pokeapi.ts knows the scheme

findings.issue: English short_effect/fallback extraction is copy-pasted from app/server/api/moves/[name].get.ts:10-12
findings.suggestion: Extract an englishEffect(resource) helper in server/utils/pokeapi.ts

findings.issue: The `labels[name] ?? humanize(name)` type-label fallback is repeated in three handlers and two pages
findings.suggestion: Add a labelFor(name) helper next to typeLabels() and use it everywhere

findings.issue: Team page re-implements the CardList grid markup instead of extending CardList (needed for remove buttons and add-order, but a second .card-grid consumer to keep in sync)
findings.suggestion: Give CardList a per-item slot (or an itemFooter slot) so the team page reuses the grid markup

summary: A well-factored Nuxt 4 BFF: every page sits behind its own /api endpoint, PokeAPI access and caching live in one server util, and the small prop-driven components (PageSection, CardList, MovesTable, TypeBadge) give the app genuine seams for extension and removal. The weaknesses are client/server duplication — humanize implemented twice, sprite URL construction inlined in the home page — that mean some bug fixes land in two places. Overall this is code a new team member could safely modify after a day of orientation.
